summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the CSV export UTF-8 encoding failure. Double-counted reconciliation work was superseded by search-rebuild optimization, then this failure.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Tenacity refactor of `ledgerly/sync/client.py`: postponed until next sprint.
- Covering index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)`: doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
- Search rebuild optimization done; full suite: 247 passed, 4 skipped.
- CSV reproduction done: `pytest tests/test_csv_export.py -q` produced 1 failed, 6 passed.
- Pending: inspect/fix decoding, then rerun `pytest tests/test_csv_export.py -q`.

## Recent work
Optimized rebuilds to 2.41s median from 16.73s, added tenant scoping, batched embedding, shared clients, bulk upserts, and migration 0042. Latest failure compares UTF-8 bytes against an incorrectly decoded string.

REASON: This explicitly configures the CSV output file to use UTF-8 before rerunning the focused tests.
